verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence addresses AI-model training on customer data: there is no training opt-out, no data-use policy, and no contractual commitment. The only relevant lever is that Hatchet can be self-hosted, running your own control plane, which keeps workflow data off vendor infrastructure and so indirectly prevents vendor-side use. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training policy or opt-out for Hatchet Cloud, documented data-use terms, independent corroboration.
